title: Lesson 2 Quiz: Creating Your Pre-Market and Post-Market Routines

questions.text: What is the primary purpose of establishing a daily maximum risk limit during a pre-market routine?
options: To decide how many trades to take each day
To prevent emotional decision-making and catastrophic losses during a trading session
To determine the exact time to exit winning positions
To eliminate the need for setting individual trade stop-loss orders
questions.explanation: Setting a clear daily risk limit beforehand ensures strict risk management and protects account capital from severe drawdowns.

questions.text: True or false: A post-market review involves logging technical metrics, reviewing emotional discipline, and updating capital records.
questions.explanation: The post-market checklist requires reviewing technical trade data, emotional discipline, and net performance results to improve trading skills.
